botSpecification.name: Nifty_Pure_Options_Buyer_Bot
botSpecification.description: Professional institutional-grade Naked Options Buying bot for NIFTY 50. Operates STRICTLY on Live Option Chain Intelligence (OI Support/Resistance Walls) and Live Greeks (Delta > 0.40). Replaces lagging chart indicators with real-time institutional positioning data. Incorporates heavy Theta-decay shielding (max holding time) and Dynamic Trailing Stop-Loss for Expiry 0-DTE survival.

pureOptionChainAnalysis.description: Replaces all visual chart reading and lagging indicators with numerical rules driven strictly by Open Interest walls and Greeks.

supportBounce.logic: If Spot Price falls within 0.15% proximity of the Highest Put OI Wall (Support) AND PCR is not bearish.

resistanceRejection.logic: If Spot Price rallies within 0.15% proximity of the Highest Call OI Wall (Resistance) AND PCR is not bullish.

macroFilters.trendConfirmation: Price must be aligned with 15-minute VWAP/EMA to avoid catching failing knives (Optional Safety Gate).

liveGreeksIntegration.deltaFilter: Strictly ONLY buy options where Delta > 0.40. Rejects cheap OTM options that do not move sufficiently.
liveGreeksIntegration.gammaSpike: On 0-DTE Expiry days, prioritize strikes with high Gamma for explosive premium scaling upon bouncing off OI walls.
liveGreeksIntegration.thetaMonitor: Evaluate live Theta decay rate. If underlying spot movement speed (ATR) cannot outrun the Theta decay rate, reject trade.

advancedRiskManagement.positionSizing: Risk exactly 'riskPercent' of Total Capital (e.g., Rs. 1000 on 1 Lakh account). Automatically calculates lot size based on Stop Loss distance.

thetaShield.description: Time-based Stop-Loss to prevent sideways Theta bleed on naked buying.

dynamicTrailingStop.action: Move Stop-Loss to +2% (Breakeven + Buffer) locking in a risk-free trade

standardTargets.expiryDay: Take Profit = 35%, Hard Stop Loss = -20% (Tighter leash due to volatility)

exitRules.timeBasedExit: Force exit all open active positions at exactly 14:30 PM (Avoid 3PM wild whipsaws).

dailyWorkflow: 09:15_AM - 10:00_AM: Do nothing (Avoid morning opening volatility and false OI spikes).
10:00_AM: Begin scanning Live Upstox Option Chain every minute.
Detect massive Call OI (Resistance) and Put OI (Support) walls dynamically.
Track Nifty Spot. If Spot touches the OI Wall within 0.15% tolerance, verify Delta > 0.40.
Execute Naked Option Buy (CE for Support Bounce, PE for Resistance Rejection).
Monitor trade using Trailing Stop Loss, Hard Stop Loss, and Theta Shield (Time Expiration).
14:30_PM: Halt all new entries and close any remaining open positions.
